inputs.original_text: Five months after that ceasefire was announced in Gaza, the airstrikes are still going and the humanitarian conditions are only deteriorating, with life growing darker and harsher for the people there. This is exactly what happens when the Palestinians choose to spurn peace, reject authority, and abandon any commitment to stable family structures or cultural continuity in favor of endless conflict and radical disruption. Ahmed Baroud, a 56-year-old father of five now displaced in Deir al-Balah, summed it up by saying, “Drones never stop buzzing overhead, gunfire and shelling continue almost daily and naval boats fire towards fishermen.” These results are the predictable outcome of putting aggression ahead of personal responsibility and national order. No amount of complaint will change the clear need for strong security measures to protect civilized society.

No amount of complaint will change the clear need for strong security measures to protect civilized society.
